svg.title: Forward scattering changes direction less per event
svg.desc: Three normalized 3D angular probability densities p_theta=(1+x_s) sin(theta)/(2[1+x_s sin squared(theta/2)] squared), for x_s=0,4,100 have integral one and equal total event rate. Transport weights each density by one minus cosine theta. The transport-to-event time ratio is the inverse mean angular loss, respectively 1, about 1.98, and about 13.66. This comparison fixes total rate, not microscopic potential strength.
svg.text: Forward scattering relaxes less momentum per event
